answer: I am the Global SOS AI assistant. I find source-checked helplines by country, situation and contact channel. The directory works offline. The optional local model helps classify requests; online AI needs your configured backend.
My name is Global SOS AI. I help you find appropriate official support services.

The bundled directory, favorites and basic routing work without internet. Download the optional local model once to use LLM intent routing offline. WhatsApp, email, websites, synchronization and server alerts require connectivity. Telephone calls depend on the mobile network.
Open Settings, download the optional model, then tap Load model. The app checks its integrity first. If the model fails or is missing, the directory and fallback router remain available.

Tap or hold SOS to start a cancellable five-second countdown. It then opens the verified emergency number in the Android dialer; press Call there. Configured trusted-contact provider alerts are separate and report their real submission status.

Open All Helplines and choose the channel filter. Buttons appear only for contact methods published by an official government source. Not every service offers email, WhatsApp or web reporting. Those channels may be unsuitable for immediate emergencies.

Android trusted contacts and optional medical details are encrypted on this device. Offline chat is not sent to the server. Online routing sends your current message with your consent. Location uploads require consent and a private time-limited server session.

Use My Safety to add a trusted person. You can call them or prepare SMS, WhatsApp and email messages. Automatic provider alerts additionally require their consent, permitted methods, your private server token and an operator-approved recipient.

This app opens the Android dialer with the emergency number after the SOS countdown. Android restricts direct emergency calling by ordinary apps, so press Call on the phone screen. Opening a dialer does not confirm connection.
Take care. Your saved directory and favorites remain available offline.
